text:
lina: Heads-up: noticed stale search results in eu-search since 09:13 after last night's rollout. Customers seeing older ranking for recent docs. Indexing pipeline looks healthy. Suspect cache invalidation flag didn't propagate. I prepared v1.10.1-hotfix (reverts TTL change and forces explicit invalidation). Need fast approval to push.
ravi: How many queries affected / customer impact?
lina: ~4% of queries returning outdated top-10, mainly for recency queries. Support tickets trickling in. Kibana: https://kibana.redwood/eu-search/errors (spike in cache-hit mismatch).
priya: Can we do a safe canary? what's the rollback plan?
ben: Oncall, what's the approval flow?
ops-oncall: Weekday window; expedited allowed with two senior eng + oncall + deploy log. Canary preferred.
lina: Canary plan: spin v1.10.1-hotfix in eu-search with 3 pods, 3% traffic for 5 minutes, watch result drift metric and 95th relevance delta. Rollback criteria: relevance-drift >1.5 or error rate increase >0.5%.
ravi: Quick confirm of change: it's a config propagation bugfix + explicit cache invalidation call. No schema or index changes. Revert is safe: redeploy v1.10.0 image.
priya: +1 from me if ops-oncall ok. I'll standby for rollback command if needed.
ben: +1. Document rollback steps here: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/eu-search --to-revision=eu-search-v1.10.0 --namespace=eu1` and `deployctl promote --service eu-search --to v1.10.0`.
ops-oncall: Approved assuming canary and the rollback runbook present.
lina: /deploy start eu1 eu-search v1.10.1-hotfix --canary=3 --note "stale-results cache invalidation hotfix"
deploy-bot: Deploy request received: eu1/eu-search -> v1.10.1-hotfix. Canary 3% (3 pods). Starting rollout.
deploy-bot: Canary pods ready: eu-search-v1.10.1-rc-1 (8s), eu-search-v1.10.1-rc-2 (11s), eu-search-v1.10.1-rc-3 (13s). Running relevance checks.
priya: Watching "top10-staleness" and "relevance-delta_p95" dashboards.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics: top10-staleness down to 0.4% (baseline 3.9%), relevance-delta_p95 stable. No error increase.
ops-oncall: Canary green. Authorizing promotion to 100% after 5m stable with same rollback criteria.
lina: /deploy promote eu1 eu-search v1.10.1-hotfix --to=100 --reason "canary green, ops approved"
deploy-bot: Promotion in progress: traffic shift 25% -> 60% -> 100%. Checks passing.
deploy-bot: Deployment complete: eu-search v1.10.1-hotfix now serving 100% in eu1. Release link: https://deploys.redwood/commit/ff12ab
ravi: Quick release note for changelog: `v1.10.1-hotfix - Fix: ensure cache invalidation flag propagation; Fix: explicit invalidation call to prevent stale top-k results`
ben: Great. I'll add a short postmortem item and ping support to close related tickets after 30m stable.
lina: Monitoring for 30m, will open incident if any regression. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
